notes.title: New Hotfix to My Cozy Room!
notes.notes: [h2]Dear Cozy Designers![/h2][p][/p][h3]Thank you for your extremely helpful feedback! Listening to your requests, we have prepared for you a Hotfix 1.1 to My Cozy Room! 📢📢📢[/h3][p][/p][p]What exactly will you find in the update? Firstly, to maximize your design experience, we have made [b]improvements in cursor functionality🖱️[/b].[/p][p]We also [b]tweaked the lighting[/b], and for those who appreciate playing by their own rules, quietly 😌, we set the [b]default ambient volume to 0 🔇[/b], and [b]lowered the volume of SFX 🔉[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534162/fb93a7326e2fab6ae6282439d8a8d668f2f9485f.png"][/img][/p][p]We're constantly taking in your feedback and working behind the scenes to implement as much as possible as quickly as possible. Thank you for your continued support! 🌞💞[/p][p][b]We hope you will enjoy playing My Cozy Room even more now![/b] 🛋️💖🧸[/p][p][/p][p][/p]
